title: Shows like The Amelia Project
description: Darkly funny, voice-led fiction about reinvention, eccentric schemes, and people who become a family by accident.
label: Dark comedy with a heart

showReasons.midnight-burger: A bigger cosmic canvas with the same warmth, running jokes, and found-family pull.
showReasons.wooden-overcoats: Small-town rivalry and character-driven absurdity keep the comic rhythm grounded in relationships.
showReasons.welcome-to-night-vale: Deadpan weirdness and a carefully maintained voice make the strange premise part of the joke.
showReasons.victoriocity: A polished full-cast mystery-comedy with eccentric characters and a strong sense of place.
showReasons.mockery-manor: A brisker comic mystery route when you want ensemble banter around an actual case.
showReasons.greater-boston: A more sprawling, relationship-first ensemble where the oddity stays rooted in human attachment.
showReasons.mission-rejected: A faster action-comedy branch for listeners who want recurring missions and a cast that keeps making things worse.
